tagline: Time tracking and invoicing for freelancers who'd rather be working
lede: Start a timer, turn your hours into a professional invoice in two clicks, and let Tallyloop chase late payments for you.
features: Track time from the browser or your phone. Forgot to start it? Add hours later in seconds.
Pick a client and a date range. Tallyloop builds the invoice from your tracked time and your rates.
Overdue invoices get friendly automatic reminders, so you don't have to write awkward emails.
Clients pay by card straight from the invoice. You see the payment the moment it lands.
Set hours or dollar budgets per project and get a heads-up at 80%, before you go over.
Export income and invoices by year or quarter as CSV or PDF for your accountant.
steps: Hit start when you begin a task. Tag it to a client and project.
At month-end, turn tracked hours into a branded invoice and send it.
Clients pay online. Tallyloop sends reminders if they don't.
faqs: Yes. The Free plan covers one active client with unlimited time tracking and three invoices a month. Upgrade only when you need more.

You can import time entries from a CSV file, which most time trackers can export.

about: Tallyloop started as a spreadsheet. Its founder was freelancing as a designer, tracking hours in one app, building invoices in another and chasing payments by email. Every month-end took an afternoon.

We built Tallyloop to make that afternoon take five minutes. It does three things well: tracks time, turns that time into invoices and gets those invoices paid. That's it. No project-management suite, no CRM, no fifty-tab settings page.
We're a small, independent team, and we answer support emails ourselves.
